CSP build

Alpine's CSP build under an enforced script-src 'self', with no 'unsafe-eval'.

Sources are data properties rather than inline expressions, because that is how components are written on a page like this one. Everything else the plugin does is plain DOM work the evaluator never touches, so it is covered on index.html rather than repeated here.

Swap a component named by a data property

The source is cardName on the host's data, and the slot content reads label from the host even though the card declares its own.

Render a literal source

A quoted string still works under the CSP build, because the plugin asks Alpine to evaluate it rather than reaching for new Function itself.

Load a template from a URL

remote-card.html is fetched and projected into, and the host emits its lifecycle events the same way it does on the default build.
